native_mechanisms: A growing sailor-chain hung between fire and wall: every shadow depends on the whole row, not just the newest knot (each new input re-mixes the entire accumulated state)
A mark's own pebble-count sets the incense-smoke's swing, bending the firelight before it lands (the word's popcount chooses the rotation amount applied when it is absorbed)
The wet-clay print taken from the settled shadow, hardened in the stream and read by its ridges, is the only thing kept as the token (lossy, one-way finalization that discards all intermediate state)
core_technique: SipHash-style ARX (add-rotate-xor) permutation over a four-word state with four interleaved lanes for long inputs and fixed finalization rounds, decorated by a data-dependent rotate-by-popcount on each absorbed 64-bit word; no multiplication.
